name: colossus-gateway
description: Colossus HTTPS MCP and function-calling tool gateway

scripts.typecheck:api: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ESNext --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node api/*.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:api && npm test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
